correctness.rationale: Every proper line cut is exhausted by the two retained pieces after symmetry. Exact centroid-projection formulas show that the quadrilateral loses a stable equilibrium only through the two original slanted sides and that the new cut side is then stable. The two failure inequalities force \(tu\ge(3-\sqrt5)/2\); the triangular retained piece costs more than \(3/4\). The equality cut is correctly treated as degenerate, so the nondegenerate threshold is an infimum. `verify.py` replays all algebra exactly.
